input.summary:
Bedroom 1 (guest/child, blue-teal) is built in parts/room-7.mjs: light-blue double bed on the centre column with a 2-high spruce headboard on the north wall, spruce-fence nightstands with birch-slab tops, a 1-wide spruce wardrobe with open trapdoor fronts on the east end of the north wall, a bookshelf with a flower pot in the north-west corner, a cyan carpet at the foot, and two hung lanterns.
make.sh gives a whole build.nbt. The part places 20 blocks with no refused writes and no off-palette blocks; room check says OK, 15 of 15 floor cells reachable, min light 10, no dark cells. The room render reads as a bedroom with the bed as the focal piece.
